maria (Finance): FYI — Stripe vs NetSuite amounts don't match for invoices in the 2026-02 batch. Stripe total = $156,320.00, NetSuite = $159,980.00. Difference $3,660. Any ideas? :thinking:

ajay (Platform): Did any stripe webhooks fail or requeue around Feb 12-13? :eyes:

maria (Finance): I checked webhook logs — most delivered, but a few 5xx retries. Not obvious which ones map to those invoices.

stripe-bot: Webhook delivery report: 2026-02-13T02:14Z 3 failures, 2 retries remaining for endpoint /webhooks/netsuite

noah (Eng): I'm pulling DLQ and webhook receipts now. Can you paste one invoice id that shows mismatch?

maria (Finance): invoice_7Gk9X — Stripe shows 12,340.00, NetSuite 13,210.00

noah (Eng): thanks. quick check: our transform pipeline had a recent change to tax line aggregation. possible rounding drift. investigating.

noah (Eng): found one suspicious log: duplicate `invoice.payment_succeeded` for invoice_7Gk9X processed twice, second time partially failed during NS push. patch queued.

billing-bot: Scheduled reprocess job `ns_push_retries` ran at 2026-02-14T03:00Z and pushed 45 events. 4 failed.

noah (Eng): here's the SQL I'm using to reconcile locally:
```
SELECT i.id, i.amount_cents/100.0 AS stripe_amount, ns.amount/100.0 AS netsuite_amount, ns.status
FROM analytics.invoice_reconciliations ns
JOIN stripe.invoices i ON i.id = ns.stripe_id
WHERE ns.batch = '2026-02';
```

noah (Eng): root cause: float rounding done before summing tax lines in transforms -> truncated cents lost across batches. Also some duplicate events caused NetSuite to create adjustment lines.

sara (Revenue Ops): did the pricing experiment from Jan cause different tax configs? We had new VAT flag in the experiment.

maria (Finance): Good catch. The experiment toggled a `vat_included` flag for EU customers starting 2026-01-25. Might explain mixed payloads.

noah (Eng): Plan: 1) hotfix to transform to sum using integer cents, 2) reprocess failed DLQ entries, 3) run reconciliation job to create NS adjustments for the delta. Deploying hotfix to staging now.

ajay (Platform): What command to re-run reconciliation? I can kick it off once patch is live.

noah (Eng): run:
```
./bin/ns_reconcile_runner --batch 2026-02 --mode fix --dry-run=false
```
Expected runtime ~20m. Will log adjustments to /var/log/billing/reconcile-2026-02.log

maria (Finance): Please tag me when dry-run is OK. We need approvals for adjustments > $1k.

sara (Revenue Ops): I'll prepare approval for any >$1k adjustments. ping me after dry-run :+1:

noah (Eng): deployed hotfix to staging. Will deploy prod at 2026-02-14T22:00 PST after quiet hours. Reprocessing scheduled immediately after.

maria (Finance): thanks. appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:

ajay (Platform): adding a monitoring alert to detect checksum drift going forward. will create a dashboard.

noah (Eng): follow-up: found 8 invoices with > $100 discrepancies. I'll attach CSV to this thread once reconcile completes.

maria (Finance): perfect — LMK when reconcile done and attach the CSV. also include which customers affected (for CS outreach).

billing-bot: Reconcile job started 2026-02-14T22:15Z. Job id: r-20260214-2215

maria (Finance): noted. :eyes:
